# Morning Live Test Checklist — Connector v1 RC

No DevTools / F12 required. Just click through.

## 104 — New Talent
1. Open a 104 candidate and trigger New Talent (import).
2. Window appears ~540–560px wide, frosted light-blue glass.
3. Top bar shows "Talent Nexus Connector" (navy glass), X at right.
4. Drag the top bar → window moves.
5. Click X → window closes.
6. Grab the ◢ bottom-right corner → drag to resize width AND height.
7. No horizontal scrollbar in normal state.
8. Form fields (Name/Mobile/Email/Industry/Function…) stay native-ish width
   (not stretched full width). Note box is wider.
9. Dropdowns open / select / save normally.
10. Click ✨ AI Fill → fills Name/Phone/Email + Note (no auto-save).
11. WeChat field NOT visible.
12. Click Pinpin Save manually → candidate saved.
13. If available: duplicate-candidate controls present and working.

## LinkedIn (quick)
14. Open a Public or Recruiter profile → New Talent capture works, AI Fill runs.

## Options
15. Open extension Options:
    - "Talent Nexus Connector" card visible (glass).
    - ATS Interface Language: 繁體中文 / English / Custom.
    - Pick 繁體中文 → Save → (reload ATS) interface is Chinese.
    - Pick English → Save → interface is English.
    - If a custom ATS URL was set, it shows under Advanced and is NOT overwritten
      by just opening Options.

Report anything that looks off before declaring v1 freeze.
